SILT#00061: I am apparently good at GeoGuessr, so here is my basic algorithm for getting close: 1) get the approximate region, 2) find signs or anything with words, especially looking out for unique points like languages and ccTLDs, 3) aim for the capital/big city. That should put you pretty close
